concerns.text: FR-014 requires drawing 500 posterior samples per event and then selecting a single random draw to create an i.i.d. point‑estimate dataset. No task in tasks.md implements the 500‑sample step; T003 draws only one sample per event.

The implementation plan (Phase 4) describes a hierarchical bootstrap resampling to produce an i.i.d. point‑estimate dataset, but none of the listed tasks (T003‑T015) perform this hierarchical bootstrap. The plan’s method is therefore uncovered.
